acceptanceCriteria: structured close decision API and CLI fields are strict and persisted; legacy human-decision invocation remains explicit and is represented with visible legacy provenance; unknown decision fields fail closed; evidence/policy refs and resume condition round-trip; tests and trilingual command docs pass
goal: Closing a Work Item preserves decision, actor, authority source, reason, evidence refs, policy refs, decidedAt, and resume condition without prescribing an approval count.
intent: Record human decisions as structured, auditable recovery-aware records.
outOfScope: Organization policy evaluation; external provider identity; release publication; automatic outcome projection
